label text with an aria-describedby hint still identifies the field
two same-named actions without a business scope are ambiguous (no first() pick)
a control behind a modal (aria-hidden) is not operable
label decorations: aria-hidden required marker and (optional) qualifier
label decoration rule does not merge different words (Tag line is not Tags)
token combobox: each tag committed with Enter and visible as a chip
token combobox that never shows tokens is an adaptation failure (not silently accepted)
editor still fading in when the chooser opens is not taken as the chooser
same text elsewhere on the page (toast) is not a second note
hidden template holding the full answer is not a note
note copy behind a modal (aria-hidden) is not counted twice
text inside an inline editor is not a saved note
highlight in an adjacent note is not attributed to this note
highlight with only a class name but no visual difference fails V-HL
editor shell kept, active controls closed -> closed
editor shell kept but title still in an editable field -> still open
modal editor dialog still shown with cleared fields -> still open
table-row note: cells are distinct lines (title cell, content cell)
table-row note: lines joined in one cell are still one line (A-K22-1 negative)
